data.title: 2% of your tax for Hradiská in 2025
data.excerpt: This year again we are applying for your 2% tax donation, so if you have not yet made up your mind, we will be very grateful for your help. The donation form can be downloaded from the link in the article.
data.metaTitle: 2% of your tax for Hradiská in 2025
data.metaDescription: In 2025 the Hradiská civic association is again applying for your 2% tax donation. Download the form and support the protection of hillforts.
